name: IREN Limited

verdict.label: Speculative
verdict.oneLine: A former bitcoin miner betting $25–30B a year on renting out AI chips, anchored by a $9.7B Microsoft deal; it all turns on funding.

summary: IREN went from mining bitcoin to renting out AI chips, signed a $9.7B deal with Microsoft, and plans to spend $25–30B this year. The film answers the eight questions that decide whether it works: whether it can pay for the build, whether the chips pay for themselves, delivery, customers, power, valuation, founders' skin in the game against their net worth, and what happened in past build-out booms. It ends with three modeled routes to 2030 with the math shown.
disclosure: Matt does not own shares of IREN and was not paid by anyone to make this video.
change: First page, built from the October 2026 film. Q1 FY2027 results (Nov 5, 2026) are not yet reflected.
